title: Using the `transfer` function of `address payable` is discouraged
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as payroll will revert and Merkle Trees & approvals would have to be done again  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it happens any time the recipient is a smart contract or a multisig wallet that has a receive function taking up more than 2300 gas  ## Description  The `executePayroll` function uses the `transfer` method of `address payable` to transfer native asset funds to a recipient address.
